caption: The video captures a close-up of a single cigarette standing upright against a dark, blurred background with fixed bokeh lights. Its lit tip, capped by ash, emits a thin smoke column that rises and shifts shape, drifting right, billowing left, and forming faint diagonal streaks. The plume meanders above the ember while the white shaft stays fixed in the frame. The smoke then becomes thinner and less visible, fading from view for the remaining frames. The burning tip and ash cap remain present, showing only subtle texture changes. Out-of-focus lights in the background stay in place, including a pale blue circle at left and a large white blur at right. A small warm spot briefly shifts on the right, but the camera itself does not move.
